Just a headsup for anyone that hasn't seen me copy/paste this list yet, there are a lot of good megaman derived games that are not crap like Mighty Number Nein:

20XX http://store.steampowered.com/app/322110/ 20XX is one of my favourite games of the past few years, and should hit 1.0 release soon. It updates with a new patch every 2 weeks, and the devs are super communicative in the Steam forum.

Megaman 2.5D http://petersjostrand.com/ This one is not done yet, but the playable demo is pretty fun, and the 2.5D is a neat gimmick.

MegaMan X Corrupted https://www.facebook.com/JKBGames This one doesn't even have a demo yet, but the videos make it look amazing, and the devs do an occasional livestream where you can ask questions and see it in action.

MegaMan unlimited http://megaphilx.com/?page_id=1003 This one is finished, and has an old school style, and old school difficulty.

MegaMan Battle Network Chrono X http://www.mmbnchronox.com/ Not finished yet, but has a demo, and the world just plain needs more Battle Network. Star Force wasn't the same.

MegaMan Super Fighting Robot https://www.facebook.com/Mega-Man-Super-Fighting-Robot-402614193259545/timeline/ Another old school game like MM Unlimited. Lots of fun.

GIGADEEP: http://www.peposoft.com/ Jap stuff. Haven't tried

MMX Eclipse: http://mmxeclipse.blogspot.com/ Demo has one stage, Project might be dead. (They claim they'll be releasing on OUYA soon, lol)

Street Fighter X MegaMan http://static.capcom.com/sfxmm/SFxMM_US.zip Fan game that got made official because Capcom is awesome like that. Not a very good game though IMO. Unlimited or SFR are far better choices for old school MM fun.
